content: Answers.com is a website that provides reference content through more than four million entries, which are aggregated from various sources. This platform was officially launched in January 2005. It serves as the flagship product of the Answers Corporation, a company that was previously known as GuruNet. Answers Corporation is an Israel-based internet reference company with operational offices located in both New York City and Jerusalem. The company was originally founded in 1999 by Bob Rosenschein. In addition to Answers.com, the Answers Corporation owns WikiAnswers, a question-and-answer platform that operates using a wiki-based system. This system allows users to collaboratively refine and improve both questions and answers. WikiAnswers is recognized as the second-largest Q&A platform, following Yahoo. Answers. The company has expressed its intention to integrate the two platforms more closely, aiming to provide users with a diverse range of answers, including both encyclopedic information and community-driven responses. The leadership team of Answers Corporation includes the following individuals: Robert S. Rosenschein, who serves as the chairman of the board, president, and chief executive officer. Steven Steinberg, who holds the roles of chief financial officer and corporate secretary. Bruce D. Smith, who functions as the chief strategic officer. Jeff Schneiderman, who is the chief technical officer.
